amd-page-3.webp.zh: 艾哈迈达巴德机场航站楼的夜景：紫色灯光照亮悬挑屋面，斜撑立柱下是车道与落客区，檐口可见古吉拉特语的机场名。
amd-page-3.webp.en: The terminal at night — purple light washing the cantilevered roof, columns over the kerbside, and the airport name in Gujarati along the fascia.

amd-page-4.webp.zh: 从落客区望向航站楼正面：白色张拉膜雨棚在车道上方展开，玻璃幕墙与斜撑构成连续立面。
amd-page-4.webp.en: The terminal from the drop-off area — white tensile canopies over the roadway, with a continuous glass-and-steel frontage.

amd-page-5.webp.zh: 航站楼内的艺术墙：线描城市景观前立着两件铜色人物浮雕，右侧信息屏显示机场全名。
amd-page-5.webp.en: An art wall inside the terminal — two bronze figures in front of a line-drawn cityscape, with a screen showing the airport full name.

amd-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 阳光下的航站楼正面，檐口一行蓝色英文字标出机场全名，立柱间的车道上有旅客与白色轿车穿行。
amd-chatgpt-01.webp.en: In daylight the terminal front carries the airport's full name in blue letters, with travellers and white cars moving along the kerb below.

amd-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 暮色渐深，航站楼沿街立面泛起紫色光，一座白色膜顶通道横跨车道，尽头是亮灯的小商铺。
amd-chatgpt-02.webp.en: As dusk deepens, purple light washes the terminal front while a white canopy walkway spans the roadway toward a lit row of small shops.

amd-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架靛蓝航空涂装的客机停在宽阔的混凝土机坪上，远处航站楼与滑行道标记清晰可见。
amd-chatgpt-03.webp.en: An IndiGo-liveried airliner stands on the concrete apron, with the terminal and painted taxiway markings visible in the background.

amd-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰航站楼：银灰色屋面分成数段，前方是停车场与环形车道，楼侧机坪停着一架客机。
amd-chatgpt-04.webp.en: An aerial view of the terminal shows a multi-part silver roof, car parks and a ring road in front, with one airliner parked on the apron beside it.

amd-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 夜色中，航站楼前广场上几顶白色膜结构天篷亮着灯，旅客在其下穿行，背景是亮灯的航站楼立面。
amd-chatgpt-05.webp.en: At night, white tensile canopies lit from below shelter strollers on the forecourt plaza, with the illuminated terminal facade behind them.

amd-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 暮色中的夜景航拍：一座上宽下窄的高塔亮着暖光，塔顶有红蓝色灯带，旁侧建筑与山下城镇灯光连成一片。
amd-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A dusk aerial of a tall tower that flares at the top, glowing warm with bands of coloured light, beside lower buildings and a lit town below the hills.

amd-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 夜间雨后的机坪上，一架靛蓝航空客机停靠在登机位，湿地面反射着灯光，机头旁有地勤车辆。
amd-chatgpt-07.webp.en: On a rain-slicked apron at night, an IndiGo jet waits at its stand while ground equipment sits near the nose.
